name: Only You Know and I Know

podcast.body: A guitar medley from Dave Mason's "Only You Know and I Know" was an acknowledged influence on Bachman-Turner Overdrive's "You Ain't Seen Nothing Yet." "this guitar medley from only you know and I know."
